I’m Dr. Olivia, an avian and exotic animal veterinarian, educator, and digital creator helping exotic pet parents and veterinary professionals provide exceptional care 🩺 🐦🐰🦎✨

On this channel, you’ll find evidence-based education on bird, reptile and exotic pet care including husbandry, behaviour, nutrition, enrichment, and early disease detection explained clearly and practically. As well as guidance on recognising, preventing and management of disease in these species. 

Whether you are a bird or exotic pet parent, animal keeper, vet student or veterinary professional, this channel is designed to build confidence, knowledge, and practical skills.

Exotic pets hide illness well, and early detection saves lives. My mission is to bridge veterinary medicine and everyday care so you can make informed decisions.

📚 Join my Exotic Pet Education community for deeper resources, checklists, webinars, e-books, and courses
📩 Subscribe to my email list for practical education and resources
